title: Normalize a cusp and certify its conductor

source.citation: Gert-Martin Greuel, Santiago Laplagne, and Frank Seelisch, Normalization of Rings, arXiv:0904.3561

translation.notes: The paper's cusp equation and test ideal are entered independently. Noether computes and verifies the normalization Q[t], coordinate images x=t^3 and y=t^2, and source conductor (x,y). This external computation supersedes the Noether-authored API seed.
